descriptors.description: Portable Descriptor fields exposed as native Version metadata with named entries

entries.name: entries
entries.description: Named portable entries; classes, optional URLs and colocated fields follow the applicable profiles

class.name: class
class.description: Exact entry class defined by the applicable profile

url.name: url
url.description: Optional absolute fragment-free HTTP(S) retrieval URL; inline-only profiles forbid it

entityid.name: entityid
entityid.description: Absolute fragment-free identity URI of the described entity; stable across retained Versions

entitytype.name: entitytype
entitytype.description: Type URI with a scheme; ontology fragments permitted; requires entityid

bundleurl.name: bundleurl
bundleurl.description: Optional direct bundle retrieval URL advertised by a supporting server
